description: Guilin University of Electronic Technology and Chinese Academy of Sciences researchers classify land use in the Lijiang River Basin for five annual epochs from 2016 to 2020. Sentinel-2 imagery is corrected, resampled to ten metres and classified with a maximum-likelihood method, followed by manual and cluster-based corrections. ScienceDB describes TIFF maps in a compressed package under CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. These land-surface classes can support catchment runoff and land-change simulations. Classification and manual corrections introduce uncertainty, and annual maps do not identify the exact dates of changes. They also do not provide channel capacities or drainage-network topology. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
